F1 · 站内信 Skill 禁止导入 store 实现，但包公开导出 store 与 token，直接调用会绕过收件人校验

文档 / Skill / 示例 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification-in-app/references/inbox-integration.md · @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app · 原评审：未解决

⌄

inbox-integration.md 第 23 行要求“不要从应用代码导入 store 实现或内部路径”，并说明数据库 Provider 在写入前通过 recipientExists 校验收件人。但 app-plugin-notification-in-app 的 /server 入口 `export * from './store.js'` 与 `./tokens.js`，因此 inAppNotificationStoreToken 与 DatabaseInAppStore 是公开导出。DatabaseInAppStore.deliver 只做重复 deliveryId 的幂等返回，本身不校验 userId 是否存在；recipientExists 校验只存在于 providers/in-app-notification.js 注册的内置 Provider send 路径。Agent 因此在应用代码中 resolve inAppNotificationStoreToken 并直接 deliver，绕过了收件人存在性校验与 Provider 的重试/失败分类。

实际影响
应用可能向不存在或已停用的用户写入站内信并触发 inbox.changed 实时事件；同时 Delivery/Attempt 诊断链路被旁路。指引与导出面自相矛盾，会反复诱导 Agent 使用非推荐的内部实现。
建议改法
二者取一：要么在 /server 入口停止导出 store 实现类与 store token（仅保留 Provider/definitions），并在 Skill 中给出受支持的编程式发送入口；要么在 Skill 中承认该 token 为受支持契约并明确它不执行 recipientExists，要求调用方自行校验。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
应用需要以编程方式写入收件箱消息（例如自动受理成功后的持久消息）
应有能力 / 行为
按 Skill 使用 in-app 渠道/Provider 发送，写入前由 recipientExists 校验收件人并取得幂等/失败分类
实际观察
包 /server 导出 store 与 token，Agent 可直接 store.deliver 写入，跳过 recipientExists 与 Provider 失败分类
应用绕行与代价
应用改用 notificationServiceToken 的 inbox 渠道发送，或在直接调用前自行查询用户是否存在
改进后的验收标准
Skill 指引与 /server 导出面一致：要么不导出 store 实现，要么文档声明其契约与校验责任

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification-in-app/references/inbox-integration.md:12–35E20

Public surfaces、禁止从应用代码导入 store 实现/内部路径，以及数据库 Provider 写入前 recipientExists 校验。

## Public surfaces

The package root and `/server` export the Server plugin and supported Server contracts. Browser or shared code imports only the topic and event types from:

```ts
import {
  IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_REALTIME_TOPIC,
  type InAppNotificationRealtimeEvent,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/realtime';
```

Do not import `server/realtime`, store implementations, or other internal implementation paths from application code.

The package's Client plugin contributes this development-only App-relative route:

```text
/dev/notification-in-app
```

Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client` in the application Client composition root. The page mounts `NotificationInAppProvider` locally and cleans up its realtime and focus listeners when navigation leaves the page. The Dev Route and its exclusive dependencies are absent from production builds.

## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/dist/server/store.js:76–107E23

DatabaseInAppStore.deliver 写入 notificationInAppItems，重复 deliveryId 时返回既有项；本身不校验 userId 是否存在。

    async deliver(input) {
        const item = {
            id: randomUUID(),
            deliveryId: input.deliveryId,
            notificationId: input.notificationId,
            userId: input.userId,
            title: input.message.title,
            body: input.message.body,
            target: validateNotificationTarget(input.message.target),
            createdAt: input.createdAt,
            updatedAt: input.createdAt,
        };
        try {
            await this.database
                .query()
                .insertInto('notificationInAppItems')
                .values(toRow(item))
                .execute();
        }
        catch (error) {
            const existing = await this.database
                .query()
                .selectFrom('notificationInAppItems')
                .selectAll()
                .where('deliveryId', '=', input.deliveryId)
                .executeTakeFirst();
            if (existing)
                return fromRow(existing);
            throw error;
        }
        return item;
    }

boot() 注册 in-app 渠道与数据库 Provider，并注入用户管理服务的 recipientExists；store token 解析为 realtime 包装。

    async boot() {
        const { container } = this.app;
        if (!container.has(notificationExtensionRegistryToken))
            return;
        const registry = container.resolve(notificationExtensionRegistryToken);
        const store = container.resolve(inAppNotificationStoreToken);
        const users = container.resolve(userAdministrationServiceToken);
        registry.registerChannel(createInAppChannelDefinition()).registerProvider(createDatabaseProviderDefinition({
            store,
            async recipientExists(userId) {
                return Boolean(await users.get(userId));
            },
        }));
    }

⌄

app-plugin-file 以“公开首版路由”实现 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes，routes.js 注释写明“Authentication and authorization are application-owned”，Skill 第 122/126 行也说明 accessPath 下的内容路由是公开异常，需应用对 <accessPath>/* 与各 <name>:<action> 自行注册认证鉴权。这要求每个需要私有附件的应用都重复实现一层受保护内容路由。

实际影响
默认把安全责任外推给应用；若应用遗漏，附件地址可被越权访问。本次应用已正确自建受保护路由，但这属于易错的高风险默认。
建议改法
为 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 增加显式的受保护模式（例如内置 auth.required()+可选记录级 policy 的顺序挂载），或让 accessPath 内容路由默认要求已注册的认证中间件，仅在显式声明 public 时才公开。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:116–126E12

accessPath/Policy 规则；“内容路由公开、Policy 不覆盖”，受限文件须由应用对 <accessPath>/* 与各动作自加认证授权，避免 use('*')。

`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

            path.startsWith(`${accessPath}/`) ||
            accessPath.startsWith(`${path}/`)))
            throw new Error(`Conflicting file accessPath: ${accessPath}`);
        paths.push(accessPath);

                throw new Error('maxSize must be a positive safe integer.');
        }
        return { ...entry, accessPath, actions, uploadOne, uploadMany };

E1 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:55–61

授权实施顺序与 Enforcement rules：注册集合/复合资源、protect 路由、authz.database 与 middleware 分工、页面授权与后台维护要求。

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

E2 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/code-and-seeds.md:99–110

权限集与分配种子的行形状表、encodeAuthorizationTitle/JSON grants、幂等与不覆盖后台修改的要求。

### Persist initial permission-set assignments

Use the actual existing user/team IDs. Check logical uniqueness before inserting missing rows; a random row ID alone does not make reruns idempotent. Do not re-add an administrator-removed assignment during every startup. A one-time seed's execution history handles when it runs; a provisioning routine that may be retried needs its own explicit completion/idempotency boundary.

A seed writes composite grants in the stored shape the definition accepts: the action names and data-scope keys its composite declares, as `{ type: 'composite', scopes }`. The Permission Set HTTP routes reject anything else, but a seed bypasses that check. Such a grant is skipped at runtime — it permits nothing while the person's other grants keep working, and a warning names it — and the startup scan of stored Permission Sets throws in development, naming the set, resource, action and problem. Fix the seed or migrate the stored grant; do not widen the composite to accept it.

| Table                                   | Row shape in addition to `id`                                            |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `authorizationPermissionSets`           | `key`, encoded `title`, JSON `grants`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`          |
| `authorizationPermissionSetAssignments` | `permissionSetKey`, `subjectType`, `subjectId`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` |

Use `encodeAuthorizationTitle` for permission-set titles, `JSON.stringify` for grants, and one transaction for dependent rows. Insert actual principals/teams before memberships and assignments. Verify foreign keys and idempotency against a real database.

E3 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/core-api.md:20–40

definePermissionSet 与复合 grant 载荷、authz.permissionSets 契约表（assign/getEffective/protect/withTransaction），主体与保护语义。

`definePermissionSet(key).title(title).grant(...grants).build()` from `@nocobase/authorization/permission-sets` returns `{ key, title?, grants }`. Each grant is `{ resource: { type, id }, actions: [{ action, policy? }] }`; build them with `authz.pages.grant(id)`, `authz.settings.grant(id, actions)` and a composite reference's `grant(...)` rather than by hand. A composite grant stores `policy: { type: 'composite', scopes }`, one value per data scope: a record access key such as `'recordsIOwn'`, or a record selection. An empty value `''` selects nothing. Titles accept strings or `{ key, ns }`.

| `authz.permissionSets`                                                                     | Contract                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `create(input)`, `update(key, input)`                                                      | A complete `{ key, title?, grants }` definition, not a partial patch    |
| `get(key)`, `list()`, `delete(key)`                                                        | Read and remove definitions                                             |
| `assign({ id?, permissionSet, subject })`, `revoke(id)`                                    | Create or remove an assignment                                          |
| `listAssignments(permissionSet?)`                                                          | Every assignment, or those of one set                                   |
| `replaceSubjectAssignments({ subject, managedPermissionSets, permissionSets })`            | Replace only the managed subset; preserve unrelated assignments         |
| `getEffective({ principal, subjects? })`                                                   | The sets an identity holds                                              |
| `protect({ owner, keys, allow?, requireActiveAssignment?, assignableTo?, unrestricted? })` | Declare code ownership and invariants; returns a release function       |
| `protection(key)`, `assertWritable(key, operation)`                                        | Read and enforce protection; `protection(key)?.unrestricted` marks root |
| `assertSubjectRemovable(subject)`                                                          | Ensure disabling or removing a subject leaves protected sets usable     |
| `withTransaction(transaction)`                                                             | Bind every store operation to a caller-owned transaction                |
| `notifyAssignmentsChanged(subject)`                                                        | Announce a change; subscribe through `authz.onGrantsChanged(listener)`  |

The platform protects the root and default sets. Root grants unrestricted access, accepts user assignments and requires a remaining active assignment; the default set's grants may be edited. Business features create their own editable sets and leave platform protection and audience assignments to their owner. Whether the current identity is unrestricted is `snapshot().unrestricted`.

Generic HTTP management rejects changes to a protected key. Owner-side service calls are trusted and bypass `assertWritable`. `requireActiveAssignment` and `assignableTo` are enforced by the assignment APIs. Relevant failures include `PermissionSetProtectedError`, `PermissionSetLastAssignmentError` and `PermissionSetSubjectNotAllowedError`.

Protected assignment changes run in a database transaction that locks the protected set before checking remaining active assignments. Custom subject `filterActive` callbacks must use the supplied transaction. When a business mutation owns the transaction, bind the service to that connection and notify after commit:

    async resolveAllGrants(input) {
        return this.toGrants(await this.getEffective(input));
    }
    grantsFor(identity) {
        // One store read per request: every derived answer comes from this promise.
        let sets;
        const effective = () => {
            sets ??= this.getEffective(identity);
            return sets;
        };
        let grants;
        const resolveAll = () => {
            grants ??= effective().then((resolved) => this.toGrants(resolved));
            return grants;
        };
        return {
            resolve: async (input) => (await resolveAll())
                .filter((grant) => this.resourceMatches(grant.resource, input.resource) &&
                grant.action === input.action)
                .map((grant) => ({ ...grant, resource: input.resource })),
            resolveAll,
            unrestricted: async () => this.hasUnrestrictedSets() &&
                this.setsAreUnrestricted(await effective()),
        };
    }
    hasUnrestrictedSets() {
        for (const protection of this.protections.values()) {
            if (protection.unrestricted)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    setsAreUnrestricted(sets) {
        return sets.some((set) => this.protections.get(set.key)?.unrestricted);
    }
    toGrants(sets) {
        return sets.flatMap((set) => set.grants.flatMap((grant) => grant.actions.map((action) => ({
            source: {
                plugin: 'permission-sets',
                id: set.key,
                ...(set.title === undefined ? {} : { title: set.title }),
            },
            resource: grant.resource,
            action: action.action,
            ...(action.policy === undefined ? {} : { policy: action.policy }),
        }))));
    }
    getEffective(input) {
        return this.resolvePermissionSets(input);
    }

E6 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/SKILL.md:27–61

Public surfaces：authenticationToken/userAdministrationServiceToken/AuthConfig/客户端 hooks 与 /api/auth/* 唯一 REST 面。

## Public surfaces

Server, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` (the root entry is the
server entry) or `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/server`:

- `authenticationToken` resolves the `Auth` instance: `required()`,
  `optional()`, `getSession(headers)`, `handler(request)`.
- `AuthEnv` types a Hono router whose routes read `context.get('auth')`.
- `userAdministrationServiceToken` resolves `UserAdministrationService`:
  `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `resetPassword`,
  `revokeSessions`, `withConnection`; errors are `UserAdministrationError`.
- `AuthConfig` is Better Auth's `BetterAuthOptions`, the type of the application's `server/config/auth.ts`. User initialization configuration lives separately under `users.initialAdmin`.
- `createAuthentication`, `databaseAdapter`, `createAuthStorage` build an
  instance outside the application runtime, mainly in tests.

Client, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client`:

- `authentication()` is the registration factory. It takes no options,
  contributes no routes, and mounts one React provider.
- `useAuthentication()` returns `{ client, session, isPending, refresh }`;
  `useAuthenticationClient()` returns the Better Auth client alone.
- `RequiredAuthentication`, `GuestAuthentication`, and
  `AuthenticationGuard({ mode })` gate a route subtree on the session.
- `AuthConfig` is Better Auth's client options, the type of the application's
  `client/config/auth.ts`.
- `authenticationClientToken` is the client's service token, used to stub the
  client in component tests.

Headless actions, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client/actions`:
`usePasswordLogin`, `usePasswordRegistration`, `usePasswordResetRequest`,
`usePasswordReset`, each returning `{ submit, isPending, error }`.

HTTP: every Better Auth endpoint is served under `/api/auth/*` by the plugin's
own route. A Better Auth plugin's endpoints appear there automatically. There
is no other authentication REST surface.

await users.disable(userId);

| Method                                              | Effect                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `list({ page, pageSize, search, status, userIds })` | Paged users; `pageSize` caps at 100; `status` is `'enabled'` or `'disabled'`                           |
| `get(userId)`                                       | One user or `undefined`                                                                                |
| `create({ name, email, username?, password })`      | Creates the user and a credential account; email and username are normalized to lower case             |
| `update(userId, { name?, email?, username? })`      | `username: null` clears it                                                                             |
| `disable(userId)`                                   | Sets `disabledAt`, deletes every session, disconnects realtime; sign-in returns `403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED` |
| `enable(userId)`                                    | Clears `disabledAt`; the user signs in again, old sessions stay gone                                   |
| `resetPassword(userId, password)`                   | Rehashes and revokes sessions                                                                          |
| `revokeSessions(userId)`                            | Deletes sessions and disconnects realtime without changing state                                       |

DefaultUserAdministrationService.list/get/create：停用/删除过滤、字面量搜索、createdAt+id 稳定分页、withConnection。

    async list(input = {}) {
        const page = positiveInteger(input.page, 1);
        const pageSize = Math.min(positiveInteger(input.pageSize, 20), 100);
        if (input.userIds && input.userIds.length === 0) {
            return { items: [], total: 0, page, pageSize };
        }
        const userIds = input.userIds;
        const search = input.search?.trim();
        // Read through the Repository rather than the Query API: its `includes`
        // matches the search term as literal text, so `%` and `_` typed into the
        // search box mean themselves instead of acting as SQL wildcards.
        const users = this.options.connection.repository('user');
        const condition = (builder) => builder.and([
            builder.date('deletedAt').empty(),
            ...(input.status === 'enabled'
                ? [builder.date('disabledAt').empty()]
                : []),
            ...(input.status === 'disabled'
                ? [builder.date('disabledAt').notEmpty()]
                : []),
            ...(userIds
                ? [builder.or(userIds.map((id) => builder.string('id').eq(id)))]
                : []),
            ...(search
                ? [
                    builder.or([
                        builder.string('name').includes(search),
                        builder.string('username').includes(search),
                        builder.string('email').includes(search),
                    ]),
                ]
                : []),
        ]);
        const total = await users.count({ filter: condition });
        const rows = await users.findMany({
            filter: condition,
            select: (select) => select.fields(...userColumns),
            // `createdAt` alone is not a total order, so a shared timestamp could
            // drop or repeat a row across pages; `id` breaks the tie.
            sort: (sort) => [sort.field('createdAt').desc(), sort.field('id').asc()],
            limit: pageSize,
            offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,
        });
        return {
            items: rows.map((row) => toAdministratedUser(row)),
            total,
            page,
            pageSize,
        };
    }

accessPath/Policy 规则；“内容路由公开、Policy 不覆盖”，受限文件须由应用对 <accessPath>/* 与各动作自加认证授权，避免 use('*')。

`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

defineSchedule 在 register()/boot() 皆可、晚于 start() 无效；Provider 示例与容器守卫写法。

There is no Server declaration field for schedules — nothing to add to `defineServerPlugin()`, and no conventional file path to discover. A schedule is registered imperatively, wherever the application or a plugin needs it, by resolving `schedulerServiceToken` and calling `defineSchedule(definition)`. Do this from a Provider's `register()` or `boot()`, guarded the same way a target registration is guarded, since the scheduler plugin might not be installed:

```ts
import { schedulerServiceToken } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler/server/tokens';
import type { AppPluginApplication } from '@nocobase/app-server/plugins';
import { ServiceProvider } from '@nocobase/service-provider';

export default class MaintenanceScheduleProvider extends ServiceProvider<AppPluginApplication> {
  public readonly name = 'app/maintenance-schedule';

  public override async boot(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.app.container.has(schedulerServiceToken)) return;
    this.app.container.resolve(schedulerServiceToken).defineSchedule({
      key: 'daily-maintenance',
      title: 'Daily maintenance',
      schedule: { cron: '0 2 * * *', timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai' },
      target: {
        type: 'app.maintenance',
        config: { batchSize: 100 },
      },
    });
  }
}
```

Add this Provider to the existing `server/providers/index.ts` array; a business plugin's own Provider belongs in its `serviceProviders` contribution instead. `key` is an application-wide stable identifier and forms the schedule's persistent identity together with the application name. Renaming it is not an in-place update, so use a namespaced key such as `sales.daily-report` when the application contains multiple business modules.

Both `register()` and `boot()` run, across every plugin, before the scheduler's own `start()` reads what was registered — so call order between plugins does not matter, only that the call happens before `start()`. A call after that point has no effect until the next sync.

Implement and register these targets first. Keep only the definitions the application needs.

| Field                   | Current contract                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `key`                   | Required; matches `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$`; unique within the application. Application name and key form persistent identity, so renaming is not an in-place update |
| `title` / `description` | Required title / optional description                                                                                                                                      |
| `schedule.cron`         | Five fields starting with minutes, or six starting with seconds; `*/5 * * * *` runs every five minutes, `*/10 * * * * *` every ten seconds                                 |
| `schedule.timezone`     | Defaults to `UTC`; use an explicit IANA timezone and consider daylight saving changes for local business time                                                              |
| `schedule.from` / `to`  | Optional inclusive `Date` boundaries; construct from ISO timestamps with explicit timezone offsets; from must not exceed to                                                |
| `schedule.limit`        | Optional positive integer; counts Queue schedule claims, not successful completions                                                                                        |
| `target.type`           | A registered target type: `workflow` with Workflow installed, or one the application or a plugin registered itself. There is no built-in type                              |
| `target.config`         | JSON object; no functions, Service instances, or credentials. Sensitive field names are rejected recursively                                                               |

`defineSchedule()` validates and normalizes the definition before adding it to the in-memory manifest for the next sync. It defaults the timezone, computes a definition hash, and freezes the stored definition. Do not construct the hash manually or mutate a definition after passing it in. There are no `enabled`, `retry`, or `overlap` declaration fields; do not insert Queue options or fields from another scheduling framework.

`target.config` is whatever the target's own `validate()` accepts. Synchronization checks that the type is registered and runs that `validate()`; anything it does not check is checked when the schedule fires. Successful synchronization does not prove the config drives correct business behavior.

Inspect the application's registered plugins and effective notification configuration before changing integration code. Missing required input blocks an actual send; use the recipient and Channel scope already authorized in the conversation and ask only for missing information.

1. Read [Notification concepts](references/notification-concepts.md) for package ownership and delivery status semantics.
2. For plugin registration, configuration, migrations, or test APIs, read [Integration and configuration](references/integration-and-configuration.md). Configure a Channel name mapped to one flat Provider configuration.
3. For sending or typed consumers, read [Sending notifications](references/sending-notifications.md). Resolve `notificationServiceToken`; construct complete messages keyed by Channel name and use native recipient addresses. Validate the intended external effect before sending.
4. For failures and retries, read [Delivery diagnostics](references/delivery-diagnostics.md). Preserve Notification, Delivery, Attempt, and retry-audit history; distinguish accepted submission from final delivery.
5. For custom transports, read [Channel and Provider extensions](references/channel-and-provider-extensions.md). Register globally unique Provider definitions through `notificationExtensionRegistryToken` and retain the queue/lease/retry lifecycle.
6. Verify changed packages and consumers with lint, typecheck, tests, and build. Cover atomic validation, independent delivery, recipient rules, and retries bound to original identities.

notificationServiceToken 发送示例、email/in-app/webhook 消息契约、幂等键语义与失败/重试区分。

Resolve `notificationServiceToken` from the shared application container. Select configured Channel names through `messages`; each value is the complete message for its Provider.

```ts
const notification = app.container.resolve(notificationServiceToken);
await notification.send({
  idempotencyKey: 'approval-123',
  source: { type: 'approval', referenceId: '123' },
  messages: {
    'system-email': {
      to: ['customer@example.com', 'reviewer@example.com'],
      subject: 'Approval result',
      html: '<p>Approved</p>',
    },
    'ops-feishu': {
      text: 'Approved',
      target: { type: 'url', url: 'https://example.com/main/approvals/123' },
    },
    inbox: {
      to: '123',
      title: 'Approval result',
      body: 'Approved',
      target: { type: 'route', path: '/approvals/123' },
    },
  },
});
```

Email requires a native email address or a non-empty readonly array of addresses, a subject, and text or HTML. Each address receives a separate email and retries independently. In-app messages require application user IDs in the same string/array shape, title, and body; final delivery checks that each user still exists. Webhook messages forbid `to`. The service does not resolve application users into email addresses or phone numbers and never defaults to the current user.

IM targets accept complete HTTP(S) URLs only. In-app targets accept a route without a deployment prefix or a complete HTTP(S) URL. React Router supplies the basename once for routes; URL targets use native links. Email links belong in text/HTML. Legacy `actionUrl` is ignored.

Unknown or disabled Channels and invalid messages or recipient formats reject the entire request before persistence or queue dispatch. Delivery-time failures are recorded independently. Reuse one stable `idempotencyKey` only for the same logical request; changing messages with that key is a conflict. Optional `source` adds business correlation. Use `getByIdempotencyKey`, `getNotification`, and `onStatusChanged` to observe results. A `retrying` Delivery is waiting for automatic execution; a terminal `failed` Delivery may be passed to `retryDelivery({ deliveryId, reason })`. An `unknown` Delivery must be checked externally before creating a new logical send.

Public surfaces、禁止从应用代码导入 store 实现/内部路径，以及数据库 Provider 写入前 recipientExists 校验。

## Public surfaces

The package root and `/server` export the Server plugin and supported Server contracts. Browser or shared code imports only the topic and event types from:

```ts
import {
  IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_REALTIME_TOPIC,
  type InAppNotificationRealtimeEvent,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/realtime';
```

Do not import `server/realtime`, store implementations, or other internal implementation paths from application code.

The package's Client plugin contributes this development-only App-relative route:

```text
/dev/notification-in-app
```

Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client` in the application Client composition root. The page mounts `NotificationInAppProvider` locally and cleans up its realtime and focus listeners when navigation leaves the page. The Dev Route and its exclusive dependencies are absent from production builds.

## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
const IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MAX_LENGTH = 191;
export function validateNotificationIdempotencyKey(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value || value !== value.trim()) {
        throw new Error('Notification idempotencyKey must be a non-empty trimmed string.');
    }
    if (value.length > IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MAX_LENGTH) {
        throw new Error(`Notification idempotencyKey must not exceed ${IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MAX_LENGTH} characters.`);
    }
}
export function notificationRequestFingerprint(input) {
    const canonical = normalizeValue({
        source: {
            type: input.source?.type ?? 'application',
            referenceId: input.source?.referenceId,
        },
        messages: input.messages,
    });
    return `v2:${createHash('sha256')
        .update(JSON.stringify(canonical))
        .digest('hex')}`;
}

{"type":"tool_execution_update","toolCallId":"call_00_hIQyLG9EyKI4kLDL64AR9630","toolName":"bash","args":{"command":"cd /home/runner/work/nb3-factory/nb3-factory/workspace && cat .agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-api-keys/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null | head -120; echo \"=== api-keys server index ===\"; cat node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-api-keys/dist/server/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-api-keys/dist/server/tokens.d.ts 2>/dev/null","timeout":30},"partialResult":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"---\nname: nocobase-app-plugin-api-keys\ndescription: Register the API Keys plugin in a NocoBase App, let scripts and integrations call the App's API with an x-api-key header, place or restrict the key management page, or work out why a key is rejected.\nmetadata:\n  short-description: Authenticate API requests with user-owned keys\n---\n\n# API Keys App Plugin\n\nUse this Skill when an App needs non-interactive callers — a script, a cron job,\na third-party integration — to reach its API as a real user, or when a key the\nApp issued is being rejected. The default configuration resolves a key into its owner’s Session and carries that user’s roles. Applications needing scoped credentials must use a separate configuration with `enableSessionForAPIKeys: false` and enforce their business rules on the server.\n\nThis package is Better Auth's\n[API Key plugin](https://www.better-auth.com/docs/plugins/api-key) plus the\n`apikey` migration, the Settings page, and the locales. `apiKey` is wrapped\nonly to supply three defaults, all overridable; its name, options and behaviour\nare Better Auth's, and Better Auth's documentation applies unchanged.\n\n## Public surfaces\n\n- Server plugin: default export of `@nocobase/app-plugin-api-keys/server`.\n  Contributes the `apikey` table migration and nothing else.\n- `apiKey(options?)`, plus `API_KEY_TABLE_NAME`, `API_KEY_ERROR_CODES` and the\n  option types, from the same entry. Use these rather than adding\n  `@better-auth/api-key` to the App: the migration here matches the schema this\n  version declares, and taking both from one package keeps them in step.\n- Client registration factory and `ApiKeysClientOptions`:\n  `@nocobase/app-plugin-api-keys/client`.\n- `apiKeyClient`, re-exported from `@better-auth/api-key/client` by the same\n  entry.\n- `ApiKeySummary`, `API_KEYS_PAGE_ACCESS`, `API_KEYS_ROUTE_ID`, and the expiry\n  helpers, for an App that builds its own page instead of using the one here.\n  The page itself reads `useAuthenticationClient().apiKey`, typed through the\n  authentication plugin's `AuthClientPluginRegistry`.\n- HTTP API: `POST /api/auth/api-key/create`, `GET /api/auth/api-key/list`,\n  `GET /api/auth/api-key/get`, `POST /api/auth/api-key/update`, and\n  `POST /api/auth/api-key/delete`. All five act only on the caller's own keys.\n\nThe plugin contributes no NocoBase route of its own. The endpoints above are\nBetter Auth's, mounted by Authentication's `/api/auth/*` handler.\n\n## Register it\n\nBoth halves are required, and each fails differently on its own.\n\n1. Add the default export to the App's `server/plugins.ts` and\n   `client/plugins.ts`. Configure the page with\n   `apiKeys({ path: '/api-keys' })`; it mounts under `/settings`.\n2. Add `apiKey()` to `plugins` in `server/config/auth.ts`, and `apiKeyClient()`\n   to `plugins` in `client/config/auth.ts`.\n3. Grant `page:api-keys/access` to the roles that may manage keys. Keys are\n   self-service and every endpoint acts only on the caller's own, so this is\n   normally granted to all authenticated users.\n4. Run `pnpm nocobase db apply`.\n\nOnly step 1 leaves the `apikey` table created and no endpoints mounted. Only\nstep 2 mounts endpoints against a table that does not exist, and every call\nfails at the database.\n\n### The three defaults\n\n`apiKey()` supplies `enableSessionForAPIKeys: true`, `rateLimit: { enabled:\nfalse }` and `requireName: true`, so an App normally passes nothing.\n\n`enableSessionForAPIKeys` is the one that has to be set. Better Auth defaults\nit off, and with it off a key authenticates nothing: the Settings page still\nissues keys, and every request carrying one answers 401. Nothing points at the\nconfiguration, so do not override it without meaning to.\n\n`rateLimit` is off because Better Auth's own default is 10 requests per key per\nday, which is a quota for issuing keys rather than for using them. Pass\n`{ enabled: true, maxRequests: 1000, timeWindow: 60_000 }` for a quota the App\nactually wants.\n\nAll three are overridable, and passing all three back reproduces Better Auth's\nown behaviour exactly.\n\n## Call the API with a key\n\n```bash\ncurl -H 'x-api-key: <key>' https://example.com/api/orders\n```\n\nAn App route needs no change. `auth.required()` and `auth.optional()` resolve\nthe key into the owner's Session, and Authorization then evaluates that user's\nroles. Read `context.get('auth')` exactly as for a cookie Session.\n\nPass `apiKeyHeaders: ['x-api-key', 'authorization-key']` to accept a different\nheader.\n\n## What a key can reach, and what it cannot\n\nA key is its owner, so it reaches the Better Auth endpoints a Session reaches.\nVerified against `@better-auth/api-key` 1.7.1 with only an `x-api-key` header:\n\n| Endpoint                                                 | Result                     |\n| -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |\n| `POST /api-key/create`, `GET /api-key/list`              | reachable                  |\n| `POST /update-user`                                      | reachable                  |\n| `GET /list-sessions`                                     | reachable                  |\n| `POST /sign-out`                                         | reachable                  |\n| `POST /delete-user`, `/change-email`, `/revoke-sessions` | 401                        |\n| `POST /change-password`                                  | requires `currentPassword` |\n\nTwo consequences to plan for:\n\n- **A key mints keys.** The successor holds its own expiry and revocation, and\n  nothing links it to the key that made it. Revoking a leaked key means\n  reviewing the owner's whole list, not deleting the one key you know about.\n- **`/list-sessions` returns the unsigned session token.** The cookie is\n  `token.signature`, so replaying the token alone does not authenticate; it\n  becomes a takeover only if the auth secret leaks too or cookie signing is\n  off.\n\nAn App that wants either closed adds its own Better Auth `before` hook\nrejecting those paths when the API key header is present. Match on the header\nrather than on the resolved Session, and place the hook before the plugin's\nown, or the Session is minted and returned first.\n\n"}],"details":{}}}

Simpler: iframe with `onError`? iframes don't reliably fire error for HTTP errors. The dialog is opened from an attachment the user can already read, so failure is unlikely. In the factory setup, the app is served same-origin (Vite proxies `/main/api`). In production, same-origin too. So fine. But for safety, blob fetch with credentials was more robust across origins. What was delivered

业务场景与交付说明

工单全生命周期可用

草稿→待分派→处理中→待确认→退回→再处理→已关闭完整跑通；退回/取消/转派均填写原因，处理记录含工时与配件，关闭后仅保留评论，日志顺序正确且重复操作不产生重复结果。

自动受理与巡检可观测

自动受理逐步记录通过/失败及失败原因（如已停用设备被拦截），历史失败不丢失；巡检以受控 Run now 触发，重复执行幂等，停用设备不生成任务，任务页可见时区、启用状态与执行结果。

越权与保密限制生效

无售后角色账号打不开业务页面与工单；协作工程师仅见被分享工单，撤销后立即失访；保密工单对协作岗位不可见，直接 URL 也被拦截；观察员看不到工时成本内部字段。

消息与运营看板联动

分派/待确认生成站内持久消息，支持未读、标记已读、删除与跳转工单，用户间隔离；主管看板统计随工单变更更新，并与可见范围一致。

原始验收要求

以主管、华东工程师、华南工程师、协作工程师、观察员分别登录，验证各自入口及允许/禁止的业务操作；角色切换不保留前一账号的权限。

实际操作

  1. 以 svc.supervisor / svc.engineer.south / svc.collaborator / svc.observer / nocobase(Super Admin) 分别登录并重新加载应用
  2. 逐页打开业务入口并尝试允许/禁止操作
  3. 以华南工程师身份打开待确认工单 WO-S-2026-0008 检查可用动作
  4. 以观察员身份创建并提交一张草稿工单
  5. 以 nocobase 打开服务页面

观察结果

  1. 主管入口完整；协作工程师仅见 仪表盘/服务工单/知识库/消息/服务助手，无 客户/设备/巡检
  2. 无售后角色的 nocobase 打开仪表盘显示 'This account has no after-sales service role.'，直接打开工单也提示不可见（越权阻断正确）
  3. 缺陷1：svc.engineer.south 在待确认工单上出现并可使用主管专属动作 Confirm / Return / Reassign（按钮 enabled，点击 Return 弹出含 Reason 的提交对话框），工程师不应确认/退回/转派
  4. 缺陷2：只读观察员 svc.observer 能新建并提交自己的工单（成功创建 SR-20260927-22615 并提交），与只读定位不符
  5. 角色切换均完整重载，未见前一账号权限残留

来源：verify-2/browser-acceptance/report.json · 原始状态：failed

原始验收要求

按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。

实际操作

  1. 服务主管新建工单并保存草稿，核对回填
  2. 提交 → 主管分派给华南工程师
  3. 工程师填写处理说明/工时/配件并 Resolve
  4. 主管 Return 并填写退回原因，工程师再次处理
  5. 主管 Confirm 关闭；检查关闭后按钮
  6. 返回/关闭操作检查日志顺序与去重

观察结果

  1. 草稿→待分派→处理中→待确认→(退回)处理中→待确认→已关闭 全链路走通
  2. 退回/取消/转派均填写原因；处理记录含 Resolution、工时、配件、内部备注
  3. 关闭后仅剩 Add comment，Resolve/Confirm/Return/Reassign/Cancel 均消失，限制生效
  4. 日志顺序正确且仅一条 Confirmed

来源：verify-2/browser-acceptance/report.json · 原始状态：passed

  3. 缺陷2：DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 预览长期停留在 'Loading preview...'（对应库已加载），拿不到文件内容
  4. 缺陷3：点击 sample.pdf 的 Preview 后浏览器标签跳到 about:blank，应用与会话丢失，无应用内 PDF 预览
  5. 缺陷4：损坏的 corrupt.png（28 字节）被接受，未做内容有效性校验

完整原始验收要求
以下仅为业务浏览器验收。逐条记录实际操作、观察、证据；模块代码/Skill 检查见独立评审评论，不能用页面通过代替代码评审，也不能要求浏览器 QA 伪造源码证据。

B01. 以主管、华东工程师、华南工程师、协作工程师、观察员分别登录，验证各自入口及允许/禁止的业务操作；角色切换不保留前一账号的权限。
B02. 新增客户和设备、编辑后刷新，验证值回填与保存；重复设备编号、无效客户设备关联有清晰反馈。
B03. 搜索、区域/状态筛选、分页、详情刷新和返回列表正常，结果不能混入无权访问的记录。
B04. 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
B05. 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
B06. 实际上传 PNG、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 小型合法文件并保存业务关联；逐格式检查显示的内容而非文件名，刷新后重新预览、下载；损坏或不支持的文件给出失败提示。文件测试样例由测试准备生成或提供，不能把浏览器 QA 自行生成文件当成浏览器操作。
B07. 用无工单访问权的普通用户尝试打开工单及其附件，不能显示内容；观察员看不到内部成本字段且不能编辑。
B08. 默认知识可读范围、指定工单跨区分享、分享撤销、保密限制分别生效；分享不能自动授予原本没有的操作。
B09. 分派后收件人消息中心出现对应持久消息，可跳转、已读/未读、删除；刷新/重新登录后状态正确，其他用户看不到；断开再恢复连接后可补齐消息。
B10. 保存成功、必填校验和一次真实失败都有正确的即时反馈，失败后未保存内容可恢复，不以 toast 冒充站内信。
B11. 从自动受理的执行记录查看步骤与实际工单结果；失败场景保留失败原因，恢复不删除旧记录或重复通知。
B12. 管理员查看巡检/超期计划，使用测试环境提供的短周期或受控触发观察实际执行；执行结束时业务结果一致，重复执行不重复创建当天巡检；停用后不再产生新任务。
B13. 看板数值与当前用户能看到的工单一致，状态变更和筛选后更新；不同岗位不出现越权统计。
B14. 管理员创建、停用、重新启用测试用户并维护岗位；停用后的原会话不可继续使用，其他业务账户不受影响。只读业务管理员可查看数据结构，但不能改表。
B15. 切换中英文，逐页检查导航、字段、弹窗、文件组件、消息及错误反馈；刷新/直接地址访问正常，不能只有中文静态页面。
B16. 服务助手未配置时准确提示且手工流程正常；配置测试模型的扩展轮次才验证真实问答、上下文范围、建议草稿、确认/拒绝和对话恢复。外部通知同理：没有测试服务标为扩展场景未执行，不声称实投成功。

API 密钥的 HTTP 调用、服务端越权/幂等、代码边界、安装引导和 Hub 发布属于独立集成/模块评审，不将它们冒充浏览器截图验收。测试角色账号可通过管理员 UI 创建，统一使用本轮测试密码配置；测试准备缺失、基础环境失败与真实业务缺陷分别报告。
